name: LangChain: Release readiness
description: DevOps workflow — Claude Sonnet — runs /release-readiness skill for release(scope): x.y.z PRs only.

prompts:
Run the LangChain Onboarding Kit **release-readiness** workflow.

**Model:** This automation is pinned to Claude Sonnet.

**Scope:** Only for `release(scope): x.y.z` PRs with version or dependency manifest changes. If this is a feature PR, stop and tell the user to run **LangChain: Review before PR** instead.

**Instructions:** Read and follow `.cursor/skills/release-readiness/SKILL.md` in this repository in full.

**Gates:** Run `.cursor/scripts/pre_merge_ci.sh --allow-deps --base master --package <path> "release(scope): x.y.z"` when applicable.

**Output:** Produce the release readiness report from the skill. Do not trigger PyPI publish — assessment only.
